Show HN: I was tired of opening 2 tabs for every HN link, so I made a userscript
items.summary:
HN is great for the links people share, but a big part of the value I get comes from reading the discussion around them. I realized I was always opening the article in one tab and the comments in another, constantly switching back and forth.

I figured there was probably a simpler way, so I threw together this userscript to merge the two.

1. Clicking a link from Hacker News opens the article with a side panel containing the discussion. It doesn't require your credentials, is resizable, and is easy to tweak if you want to customize it.

2. If you land on an article that has previously been shared on HN, the script finds the existing discussion and adds a button in the top-right to open the panel.

Feedback welcome.

items.title: Improving electric vehicle efficiency in power conversion - The Manufacturer
items.summary: # Improving electric vehicle efficiency in power conversion. Image 9: Improving electric vehicle efficiency in power conversion. **Electric vehicles rely on power electronics to convert battery energy into power for the motor. A key part of this control is the ‘gate driver’, which determines how fast a switch turns on and off. *   **Why is power conversion efficiency so important in electric vehicles?**: Every electric vehicle relies on power electronics to convert energy from the battery into power for the motor. *   **What is the biggest challenge with conventional gate driver technology?:** Traditional gate drivers rely on a fixed resistor to control how quickly semiconductor switches turn on and off. *   **How does the EleVait project offer a different approach?:** Rather than using multiple switching configurations or complex feedback systems, the University of Bristol’s Electrical Energy Management Research Group developed a simpler three-step switching method that operates using a single fixed pattern.

result.actual_text:
Dưới đây là một đoạn code HTML đơn giản tạo một nút bấm có chức năng đổi màu nền của trang khi được nhấn:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Đổi Màu Nền</title>
    <style>
        body {
            transition: background-color 0.5s;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <button id="colorButton">Đổi Màu Nền</button>

    <script>
        const button = document.getElementById('colorButton');
        button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            document.body.style.backgroundColor = 
                document.body.style.backgroundColor === 'lightblue' ? 'lightgreen' : 'lightblue';
        });
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```

### Hướng dẫn sử dụng:
1. Sao chép đoạn mã trên và dán vào một tệp tin có đuôi `.html` (ví dụ: `index.html`).
2. Mở tệp tin đó trong trình duyệt web.
3. Nhấn nút "Đổi Màu Nền" để thay đổi màu nền giữa màu xanh nhạt và màu xanh lá cây.

items.title: Moburst develops AI engine optimization capabilities for established companies - TechCrunch
items.summary: Mobile growth agency Moburst has built out a dedicated AI Engine Optimization practice aimed at established companies with existing app portfolios, betting that the category still lacks agencies with real depth rather than a rebranded service page. AI Engine Optimization, more commonly abbreviated AEO for Answer Engine Optimization, is the practice of structuring a brand’s content and web presence so AI systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews can confidently cite it when answering a user’s question directly, rather than showing a ranked list of links. For established companies vetting an AEO partner, the practical test is whether the agency can point to specific app-store-side work, not just web content changes, and whether it can describe a concrete process for reconciling inconsistent brand descriptions across many independent sources rather than treating that as someone else’s problem.

items.summary: # Over 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development'. Senior officials at some of the nation's leading AI companies say it's time for the federal government to find a way to put the brakes on AI development if it's needed. "We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development," reads an open letter signed by more than 1,100 AI workers from companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta. The letter zeroes in on "automated AI development," which refers to when AI will be capable of developing itself, something the industry calls "Recursive Self-Improvement." Protecting My Server and Knowing What It Does with Tailscale and Beszel
items.summary:
I recently spent a weekend improving my VPS setup, and I ended up learning a lot more about networking than I expected.

I had two problems that kept nagging me

My SSH port was still exposed to the internet. I know it's generally safe with key-based authentication, but I never liked leaving it open.

I had no easy way to know if a service had crashed or how much CPU, RAM, or disk space my VPS was actually using and I didn't want to SSH into it to see what's happening everytime.

The solution I ended up with was Tailscale + Beszel.

While setting it up, I went down a rabbit hole learning how Tailscale works under the hood with WireGuard, NAT hole punching, DERP relays, and how SSH still works over a UDP based VPN.

I wrote everything I learned into a blog post with a detailed guide on setting up Tailscale and Beszel.

https://syedfazil.dev/blogs/tech/tailscale-beszel-vps/

I am looking to help anyone who is facing the same problem and for feedback from experienced folks
